patch_description:
Replace the unstructured Gaussian cloud with a deterministic optimization of seven lines through the origin, returning both antipodal endpoints of every line. This guarantees a maximum pairwise distance of exactly 2 while reducing the problem to minimizing the maximum absolute inner product between seven unit directions.

For antipodal unit vectors, the minimum point distance is `sqrt(2 - 2*max_abs_dot)`, so improving the line-packing coherence directly improves the evaluator’s squared min/max ratio. The implementation uses reproducible multi-start projected optimization on the sphere with an annealed smooth maximum objective, then returns the best fourteen antipodal points.
